appointment.title: Start your classes
appointment.intro: Complete the form for your first class. Choose an available date and time below and reserve your spot — your class will take place live over Zoom with one of our instructors.

items.title: 1. Choose your style & time
items.text: Browse open dates and hours and pick the slot that fits your schedule.

items.title: 2. Confirm your booking
items.text: You'll receive a Zoom link and class details by email once your slot is confirmed.

items.title: 3. Pay directly with us
items.text: Payment for your class is arranged manually with our team after booking — no online payment needed yet.

items.title: 4. Show up & dance
items.text: Join the Zoom link at your booked time and start moving.

appointment.widgetPlaceholder: Our live Zoom scheduling calendar will be embedded here. In the meantime, choose a slot and we'll confirm by email.
appointment.paymentNote: Payment is currently handled manually with our team after your booking is confirmed — no payment is collected on this website.
